answer: Identity Cost Ladder. Each new agent identity must hold a violet ledger entry whose minimum balance rises with the total count already registered under the same operator: the nth identity requires n times the base holding, locked for a fixed term. An attacker registering many identities pays a triangular sum, not a flat fee, so mass registration becomes quadratically expensive. A lantern audit trail links entries to operators. Each identity also needs an opal attestation refreshed per term, adding recurring cost.
